notes: Recorded 404 Master's programme rows at 62 eligible universities, taken from the 490 English-language Master's entries on the official Study in Poland finder (20 pages, 25 per page; the finder states no total). 420 of the 490 entries belong to universities on the NAWA Attachment 2 list; 16 of those were exact duplicates and were merged (404 rows).

70 finder entries were left out because their university is not on the Banach framework-agreement list: Academy of Music in Cracow, Katowice School of Economics, Maritime University of Szczecin, Medical University of Bialystok/Gdansk, Military University of Technology, Philological School of Higher Education in Wroclaw, Polish Air Force Academy, Polish Naval Academy, State University of Applied Sciences in Konin, Eugeniusz Geppert Academy of Art and Design, Paderewski Academy of Music in Poznan, Karol Szymanowski Academy of Music in Katowice, University of Arts in Poznan, University of Humanities and Economics in Lodz, WSB Merito (Bydgoszcz, Opole, Torun, Warszawa, Lodz), WSG University, Wroclaw Medical University, Wyzsza Szkola Biznesu - National Louis University.

Programme name is the finder's field name (for example 'Computer science', 'Management'); where the finder shows a specific programme title instead (a few Czestochowa, Gdansk, Krakow entries), that title is in the detail text. Detail gives the faculty, duration, area group and the application-deadline year the finder entry shows; many entries are older (deadline years from 2014 to 2027), so editors should treat them as the university's published English offer, not as confirmed for the 2027 intake.

Not included: programmes taught in Polish (the Polish-language finder is a separate interactive search), long-cycle Master's programmes (the Banach call requires a first-cycle degree for second-cycle studies) and the NAWA one-year preparatory course (no programme names). 'any_subject' is left unset because the call does not use the words 'any field'; the call sets no field limit.
The university list used is the 2026/27 Attachment 2 attached to the 2026 call; the next call may change it.
